description: Language × Format Coverage Matrix mapping verified candidates, possible sources, and gaps across Mnemo natively supported parser families.

status_legend.ADMITTED: Already represented in frozen Phase 8.5 Golden Corpus
status_legend.VERIFIED_CANDIDATE: Specific public source with confirmed document-level artifact, known URL, and verifiable Devanagari text
status_legend.POSSIBLE: Candidate domain or portal identified, but direct file URL or exact format variant requires confirmation
status_legend.NOT_FOUND: Exhaustive discovery round found zero authoritative, non-scraped public documents in this format
status_legend.NOT_APPLICABLE: Format does not extract textual semantic content natively (e.g. standalone image without external OCR)

PDF.notes: Abundant coverage across technical, resume, academic, and philosophical texts in Golden Corpus.

XLSX_CSV.notes: 5 Excel workbooks (`ME381 Lab...xlsx`, `Health Check Up...xlsx`) + 1 CSV (`Y24_CPI.csv`).

TXT_MD.notes: 1 Markdown research file + 1 plain text file.

Image.notes: 8 JPEG personal photos in Golden Corpus.

candidates.title: Ministry of Education Annual Report 2023-24 (Hindi)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Government of India
candidates.suitability: High — official government report with continuous prose, tables, and statistics.

candidates.title: National Education Policy 2020 (Hindi Authoritative Text)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Government of India
candidates.suitability: High — structured policy document with rich Devanagari terminology.

candidates.title: NCERT Kshitij Bhag-2 (Class 10 Hindi Literature)
candidates.suitability: High semantic value, but high license restriction (electronic redistribution prohibited).

candidates.title: INFLIBNET e-PG Pathshala Postgraduate Course Modules
candidates.suitability: Requires confirmation of unauthenticated DOCX download availability.

candidates.title: NCERT Teacher Training Workshop Presentation Slides
candidates.suitability: Slide-level Devanagari headings; requires verified direct binary URL.

candidates.title: data.gov.in Census and Demographic Statistics with Bilingual Headers
candidates.publisher: Government of India Open Data Portal

TXT_MD.notes: Prior TXT-only archives (Politics.zip, Science & Technology.zip) were deleted under Part A. Plain text may be considered only as supplementary after format-diverse baseline is established.

Image.notes: StandaloneImageParser does not extract text. Text extraction requires external OCR provider, which is not unconditionally supported.

candidates.title: Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2023-24 (Marathi)
candidates.publisher: Commissionerate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
candidates.suitability: Highest priority Marathi candidate — comprehensive official economic survey with prose and tables.

candidates.title: Maharashtra State Budget Speech 2023-24 (Marathi)
candidates.suitability: High — authentic formal Marathi legislative text, public domain.

candidates.title: Balbharati Marathi Literature Textbook (Kumarbharati Class 10)
candidates.suitability: High educational prose quality; license scope requires governance decision.

DOCX.notes: State educational portals and government bodies in Maharashtra publish exclusively in PDF. Zero authoritative public Marathi DOCX files identified without authentication barriers.

PPTX.notes: No verified direct-download Marathi presentations identified from public government or educational repositories.

candidates.title: Maharashtra Directorate of Economics and Statistics Tabular Abstract
candidates.suitability: Low semantic value; tables are predominantly numeric.

TXT_MD.notes: Partial MNATD.zip was deleted under Part A. No other legitimate continuous Marathi plain-text dataset is currently under evaluation.

Image.notes: StandaloneImageParser does not extract text. Text extraction requires external OCR provider.
